atoms.text: Ulysses was a great big bear with a great big smile. He was very friendly and liked to talk to all the other bears. One day, he realised something fishy was going on.
atoms.sound: ssml: Ulysses was a great big bear with a great big smile. <break time='500ms'/> He was very friendly and liked to talk to all the other bears. <break time='500ms'/> One day, he realised something fishy was going on.

atoms.text: He knew something strange was happening when he arrived at the river. Normally, all the other bears would be there catching fish too, but it was strangely empty.
atoms.sound: ssml: He knew something strange was happening when he arrived at the river.<break time='500ms'/> Normally, all the other bears would be there catching fish too, but it was strangely empty.

atoms.text: On his way home, Ulysses wondered why all of his friends were gone. Then, he passed by a friend’s den. “That’s it!” thought Ulysses. He was going to ask his friend where everyone was.
atoms.sound: ssml: On his way home, Ulysses wondered why all of his friends were gone. <break time='500ms'/> Then, he passed by a friend’s den. That’s it! Thought Ulysses. <break time='500ms'/> He was going to ask his friend where everyone was.

atoms.text: He stuck his nose in the den and found his friend in a deep slumber. “Huh?” thought Ulysses. And then it hit him: it was time to hibernate! Ulysses went back to his own den and began the long sleep.
